```yaml
name: Infisical Testing

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Set up Pixi
        uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.9.3
        with:
          pixi-version: latest
          manifest-path: pixi.toml
          run-install: true
          environments: dev

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Type check
        run: npm run type-check

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
```
